verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs cover some data-transfer paths. The CLI hello-world walkthrough includes a "copy data" step, the SSH guide covers transferring files securely, and Jupyter's direct connection is described as faster for uploading and downloading local files. Community reports of inconsistent or poor instance bandwidth weaken the "efficiently" part but do not contradict the tooling itself. Missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync integration, in-depth documentation of the transfer commands themselves, independent corroboration of transfer performance.
